rot.ideia.ex1.e1: The rook mate brings the last lessons together: the rook cut, the opposition and zugzwang.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: It almost always ends like this: the black king on the edge and your king facing it.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: Your king guards the squares in front. Only the rook's check on the edge is missing.
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: Checkmate! The rook attacks the edge, and your king guards the 7th rank.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The rook goes to h8 and checks along the edge. The black king has nowhere to go.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.h1h7.1: The rook closes the 7th rank, but gives no check.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.h1h7.2: The black king steps away from yours.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.h1h7.3: Let's go back: with the kings face to face, give check on the edge.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That move is not mate. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: Remember the picture: black king on the edge, your king facing it, rook check on the edge.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: Here the kings are not face to face. A check now is not mate: the black king escapes sideways.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: Cut off the file on the side away from your king. The black king will only have c8, facing yours.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Leave the black king a single square, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! The rook closes the e-file, and the black king can only go to c8.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The rook goes to e1 and closes the e-file. The black king only has c8, facing yours.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c6d6.1: That works too: the king goes in front. But the black king still picks a side.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c6d6.2: Look also at the rook on e1: the black king is left with a single square.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.h1h8.1: It is check, but the kings are not face to face.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.h1h8.2: The black king escapes through e7.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.h1h8.3: Let's go back: first, leave the black king with a single square.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move leaves the black king more than one square. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Leave the black king a single square, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The black king goes to c8, the only square.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Checkmate! Kings face to face, and the rook checks on the edge.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Remember: without the kings facing, a rook move forces the black king to face yours.
rot.ideia.ex2.l4: Now I will show how to push the king to the edge and how to wait with the rook.
rot.demos.empurra.e1: The rook on h6 cuts off the black king. The kings face each other, and it's White's turn.
rot.demos.empurra.l1: The rook gives check on the 7th rank.
rot.demos.empurra.l2: The black king cannot stay on the 7th rank or come down: it goes to the edge.
rot.demos.empurra.l3: Each check with the kings face to face pushes the black king back one rank.
rot.demos.empurra.l4: Then your king climbs too, and the rook repeats the check on the next rank.
rot.demos.espera.e1: The black king is on the edge. The rook on h7 closes the 7th rank.
rot.demos.espera.l1: The black king steps away from the white king.
rot.demos.espera.l2: A waiting move: the rook stays on the 7th rank, and the black king has to move.
rot.demos.espera.l3: If it went back to d8, it would face your king: mate. It goes to b8.
rot.demos.espera.l5: The black king reaches the corner.
rot.demos.espera.l6: The white king stays close. Now the black king only has b8.
rot.demos.espera.l7: The black king goes to b8, facing the white king.
rot.demos.espera.l8: Checkmate! Waiting forced the black king to face yours.
rot.demos.espera.l9: Now it's your turn: cut, push, wait and give mate.
rot.pratica.corte.enunciado: Give checkmate. Cut with the rook and leave the black king only the square facing yours.
rot.pratica.corte.fim: Perfect. The cut forced the king to face yours, and mate followed.
rot.pratica.corte.err.a1a8: It is check, but the king escapes through d7. Try again.
rot.pratica.borda.enunciado: The black king is on the edge. Close the 7th rank, bring your king in front of it and wait.
rot.pratica.borda.fim: Well done. Now the whole way, from the center.
rot.pratica.centro.enunciado: Cut with the rook, bring your king to face the black one and check. Repeat to the edge.
rot.pratica.centro.fim: Magnificent! You gave the rook mate against the machine.
